Fonts built into edf2027.exe for the F1 settings menu and the performance overlay
(tools/embed-fonts.cmake turns them into byte arrays at build time).

Inter-Regular.ttf, Inter-SemiBold.ttf
  Inter 4.001 by The Inter Project Authors (https://github.com/rsms/inter), the
  Latin subset as published by Fontsource
  (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/fontsource/fonts/inter@latest/latin-400-normal.ttf and
  latin-600-normal.ttf). SIL Open Font License 1.1: LICENSE-Inter.txt.

fa-solid-900.ttf
  Font Awesome Free 6.7.2, solid style, unmodified
  (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free@6.7.2/webfonts/fa-solid-900.ttf).
  Font files: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (Reserved Font Name "Font Awesome"), which is
  why the file is shipped whole rather than subset. LICENSE-FontAwesome-Free.txt.

Copies of both licenses are also in LICENSES/ for the release package.
